guard: a session Cotal launched refuses every Cotal tool of a server other than its local one, through the shipped hook bundle, while a plain session keeps the hosted connector
why: Claude Code loads connected-account connectors in a launched session by default, so a hosted Cotal connector beside the local plugin let one session join twice. Reproduced live: a launched seat joined its local mesh as probe and the hosted gateway as hosted_probe.
The suite runs dist/hook.cjs, the file hooks.json runs, so every mutation rebuilds before the run and after the restore.

O1 and O2 cut the two wires (the relay ignoring the answer, the hook not passing it). O3 inverts the server test. O4 is the liveness arm: refusing the local server too. O5 opens the identity gate, so a plain session would lose the hosted connector. O6 and O7 pin the tool-name test at both ends of its tool part.

mutations.name: O1 the relay never applies the local answer
mutations.expectRed: a launched session refuses the hosted mcp__claude_ai_Cotal__cotal_connect
mutations.cell: a launched session refuses the hosted mcp__claude_ai_Cotal__cotal_connect
mutations.note: The pre-fix behavior: every hosted call relays, and with no reachable socket the hook prints nothing, so the call runs.

mutations.name: O2 the hook runs the relay without the one-path answer
mutations.expectRed: a launched session refuses the hosted mcp__claude_ai_Cotal__cotal_connect
mutations.cell: a launched session refuses the hosted mcp__claude_ai_Cotal__cotal_connect
mutations.note: The shipped hook.ts before this change.

mutations.name: O3 the server test is inverted
mutations.expectRed: a launched session refuses the hosted mcp__claude_ai_Cotal__cotal_connect
mutations.cell: a launched session refuses the hosted mcp__claude_ai_Cotal__cotal_connect
mutations.note: Hosted calls pass and local ones are refused; the first hosted cell reddens before any local one runs.

mutations.name: O4 the local server is refused too
mutations.expectRed: a launched session passes mcp__cotal__cotal_send through
mutations.cell: a launched session passes mcp__cotal__cotal_send through
mutations.note: Liveness: every refusal cell stays green, so only the pass-through cell can catch an answer that refuses all Cotal tools.

mutations.name: O5 the identity gate no longer protects a plain session
mutations.find: if (!hasIdentity()) return done(""); // plain session, not a managed one — no-op
mutations.replace: if (!hasIdentity() && !answer) return done(""); // plain session, not a managed one — no-op
mutations.expectRed: a session Cotal did not launch keeps the hosted connector
mutations.cell: a session Cotal did not launch keeps the hosted connector
mutations.note: The answer itself does not read the environment; the relay's identity gate is what keeps a plain session's hosted connector working.
